changelog.notes: Simplified make app/web/stop/restart workflow. Docker auto-start and Piston runtime auto-install on demand for any language. Difficulty levels (Beginner/Amateur/Intermediate/Advanced/Expert) added to Code Lab and AI Exam with pill selectors. Solution checker with per-test-case pass/fail. AI proxy support via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.

Native macOS app via Tauri v2: bundled Node.js sidecar, optional Docker service management (Launch/Stop ChromaDB+Piston from the app), service health bar in UI, data stored in ~/Library/Application Support/studytrack/.
AI exam generator, embedded code lab with Piston sandbox, per-objective coding environment, GitHub-style activity heatmap, ChromaDB RAG integration, Docker stack with Makefile.
Initial beta release. GCP ML Engineer study plan, inline editing, JSON editor, notes, custom task types.
